# Overall Project Summary: Aug 9, 2026

Development on August 9 focused on stabilizing the Eliza framework through modular UI migrations, critical runtime bug fixes, and significant CI/CD pipeline improvements. The team successfully restored Gmail functionality and addressed core orchestration issues, while ongoing efforts remain centered on resolving cloud infrastructure latency and agent provisioning stability.

## 🚨 Needs Attention 
- **[elizaos/eliza#16961](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16961) (Cloud Warm Pool):** Requires input on digest-aware rollout status and daemon-owned capacity guards to resolve image-drift issues.
- **[elizaos/eliza#18049](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/18049) (Auth Latency):** Investigation into multi-second provider lookup spikes needs further analysis to reduce bootstrap latency for onboarding.

## ✅ Completed Work

### Core Runtime & Agent Orchestration
- Fixed planner loop failures to ensure tool results are preserved even during mid-turn interruptions ([elizaos/eliza#18180](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18180)).
- Enhanced agent engagement by suppressing meta-narration and improving routing gates ([elizaos/eliza#18174](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18174), [elizaos/eliza#18177](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18177)).
- Improved task management by reaping stuck tasks and preventing internal instructions from leaking into chat ([elizaos/eliza#18118](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18118), [elizaos/eliza#18164](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18164)).

### UI & Connector Migration
- Migrated settings to a modular, connector-based architecture with dedicated detail pages ([elizaos/eliza#18175](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18175)).
- Enabled in-process token redemption to resolve app-host pairing issues ([elizaos/eliza#18178](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18178)).
- Refined browser workspace UX by cleaning up chat composer controls ([elizaos/eliza#18124](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18124)).

### CI/CD & Google Workspace Stability
- Restored Gmail sending capabilities with new security fail-safes against header injection ([elizaos/eliza#18112](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18112), [elizaos/eliza#18121](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18121)).
- Stabilized CI test lanes by serializing dependencies and bounding worker teardowns ([elizaos/eliza#18193](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18193), [elizaos/eliza#18136](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/18136)).
